item.description: A small device that gently stimulates nerves through the ear could offer a new way to tackle stubborn high blood pressure. item.description: A groundbreaking study challenges 70 years of assumptions about how human language works. Even more surprisingly, human language shows a powerful hidden preference for safety, suggesting that our words may reflect ancient survival instincts. Fuente: ScienceDaily.
